resource.title: Neurorehabilitation Experience Questionnaire (NREQ) Items
resource.publisher: University of Surrey / Surrey Community Health

text.div: NREQ item codes (Q01–Q17) with linkId, type, required, binding, domain, and order.

concept.definition: When I arrived I was given information about the unit and what would happen during my stay
The facilities on the unit were good (e.g., washing facilities, toilets)
There was somewhere secure to keep my belongings
I was able to discuss personal matters in private
There were enough things to do in my free time (e.g., watch TV, join a group)
There was a friendly atmosphere on the unit
I felt the staff really cared about me
The staff worked well as a team
I felt able to talk to the staff about any problems I had
I was asked what I wanted to achieve during my stay
I felt as though the staff and I were partners in the whole process of care
The staff kept me informed every step of the way
My family or carer was involved in discussions about my treatment if I wanted them to be
I am happy with the amount of therapy or treatment I received for...
I received enough emotional support
I am feeling well supported and prepared for my discharge
I am satisfied with the progress I have made during my stay
Please describe your experience accessing neurorehabilitation services or contacting your care team when you needed support.
In what ways did the rehabilitation program address (or not address) all of your needs (physical, cognitive, emotional, social)?
How did the consistency of working with the same rehabilitation professionals impact your experience?
Can you describe how well your different rehabilitation professionals (therapists, doctors, nurses, psychologists) shared information and worked together over time to support your recovery?
Can you describe how well your different specialists (therapists, doctors, nurses, psychologists) worked together in your rehabilitation?
Please share any experiences where you felt safe or unsafe during your rehabilitation (e.g., exercises, therapies, medication).
How well did the rehabilitation team listen to your personal goals, preferences, and values?
How did the rehabilitation team help (or not help) you develop skills and strategies to manage your condition in daily life?
What made you trust (or not trust) your rehabilitation team?
On a scale from 0 to 10, how likely are you to recommend this rehabilitation program to a friend or family member in need of similar care?
What is the main reason for your score?

resource.name: NeuroRehabPREM
resource.title: Patient Reported Experience Measure – Neurorehabilitation
resource.description: Open-ended PREM questionnaire for neurorehabilitation, structured along PaRIS framework domains.
resource.purpose: To capture patient-reported experiences in neurorehabilitation for NLP-based sentiment and topic analysis.
